rationale: The asynchronous FIFO uses gray-pointer synchronizers in both directions, and its write and read clocks are correctly unrelated with interface delays assigned to their owning domains.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the asynchronous FIFO to four eight-bit entries with two-stage gray-pointer synchronizers.

mutation.description: The reduced memory implementation retains independent write/read pointers and both CDC synchronizer directions.
